Tom found a small box. Inside the box, he saw a big, furry dog. The dog was trying to walk and play, but Tom knew he should not go in. He was very scared, but he listened to his mom and dad.
Tom tried to walk in the box, but it was too big. At first, he could not go inside. He did not know what to do. Then, he had an idea. He went to a pond full of water and filled a tiny pool. Now, Tom could play in the water with his new friend, the brown dog.
After a while, the dog was done. Tom was happy he could play in the pool. He said goodbye to his new friend and went home. Tom knew that the dog and the brown dog had a fun day in the box.
